Perform a sealed request/response operation that cannot expose a raw transport.
Bind and accept through an explicit internet or Unix listener resource.
Issue a caller-visible standalone DNS query for exact record types.

UID, GID, and credential mutation remain closed.

Heap, profiler, report, core, and runtime-control inspection remain closed.

Namespaced storage reads stay closed until native isolation is proven.
Namespaced storage writes stay closed until native isolation is proven.
